# 3 bed detached house for sale

> Bergins are delighted to present Woodmere, a detached three bedroom home of approx. 231 sq m (2,487 sq ft) on Ballinclea Road. It was designed and built in 2014 with comfort, efficiency and flexible living in mind. Behind a gravel drive with parking for two cars, the house has a clean, contemporary twin gable front with tall windows and a brick band detail.

## Fakta
- Typ: detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 3 bed
- Plocha: 231 m²
- Energetická náročnost: B
- Lokalita: Woodmere, Ballinclea Road, Killiney
- Cena: 1 450 000 €
